title: Family-office accounting reference library
scope: US-first family-office accounting, investment, fiduciary, tax, reporting and financial operations; selected named state and international interfaces.
user_priority: Gather context and sources so a human or agent can access useful guidance easily. Textbook authoring is not the deliverable.
publication_status: Portable research package; not imported, merged or deployed
review_boundary: Source-discovery and selected-page checks, not comprehensive full-text technical review or professional signoff
rights_boundary: No publisher full text or private family evidence included
storage_note: Source rows are losslessly reconstructed by recursively overlaying each row on source_defaults; arrays replace, never merge. Topic routes are normalized to remove repeated source lists and old repository links. This is intake data, not publisher full text.

applicability.basis: Editorial discovery classification, not an entity-specific applicability conclusion
applicability.required_context: Select the relevant context packets in the topic route before relying on this source.

source_defaults.corpus_duplicate_check: Exact registry reconciliation required before import
source_defaults.locator_type: section/navigation hint; not a claim-level verified quotation

maintenance.before_use: Recheck source edition, operative period, applicability and access before relying on a technical conclusion.
maintenance.change_review_trigger: Publisher replacement, new rule/standard, corrected form, new reporting year or changed entity facts.

source_defaults.preferred_retrieval: Open original HTML and navigate to the indicated section; follow publisher access terms

rights.note: Links and original annotations only. Publisher terms govern source access, copying, redistribution and automated retrieval.
